browser: Chrome for Testing via Playwright, real unpacked extension, grants prepared through the product by the owner

checks.name: A page opened as the browser starts gets hold-drag within seconds, without a reload
All-sites scope: one registered script covers http and https; the switch shows it on
Hold-drag works on a second origin with no per-site grant and no prompt
Modifier trigger on a real page: Meta-drag selects; a plain Meta-click opens the link as usual
Never on these sites: off at once in the open tab, off after a reload, and back on without a reload
This site, in all-sites scope, is the Never on this site toggle
Capture this page on a never-visited origin needs no prompt with all-sites access, and reads its frame from another site

Frames from other sites with all-sites access: every frame is read (nested, sidebar, inside a closed component, sandboxed), each link once with its frameUrl and context, a hidden frame not at all, with no prompt; content links only leaves the sidebar frame’s link out

Capture this PDF where the site is already allowed and the toolbar was not clicked: known as a PDF with or without ".pdf" in its address, previewed, added with the PDF as the source page, and no prompt
Save tabs as links with all-sites access reads each tab’s own citation tags (Highwire, PRISM, JSON-LD, Dublin Core) into the collection’s pages, without a prompt
Open as a tab group names the group after the collection when tab groups are allowed
Card: Open as a tab group is named after the destination; Bookmark this selection saves a folder
Capture their pages with all-sites access: pages on two sites and a PDF, each in a background tab that is closed, one batch, one Undo, no prompt
Follow Next crosses to another site where Link Meteor has access to it

PDF files with all-sites access: PDFs on two sites into one ZIP, each through a background tab on its own site that is closed again; one sent as a download; one that moves to the other site; one Chrome downloads by itself, into the profile’s own folder; no prompt
The switch turns all-sites off (offering to remove Chrome’s grant) and on again
